verdict.rationale: Letta's 'dreaming' feature has background subagents review conversations and consolidate lessons into memory, and '/doctor' audits memory placement/duplication — both are forms of AI-generated insight generation, but they operate on the agent's own conversational memory rather than a user's broader dataset. Missing for 10: evidence of the product analyzing arbitrary user data (files, documents, business data) to surface proactive insights/suggestions, and any hands-on/independent validation that these insight features work well in practice.
